units.source_text: 吴六段频繁弈战，弄坏了身体。

en.t: Wu Sixth Dan played match after match so often that he ruined his health.

units.source_text: 对中国和日本发生战争一事感到痛心，

en.t: grieving over the outbreak of war between China and Japan,

units.source_text: 企盼早日迎来和平的日子，

en.t: and hoping that days of peace would come soon,

units.source_text: 让日中两国的雅客泛舟风光明媚的太湖。

en.t: so that refined guests from Japan and China could go boating on the beautiful waters of Lake Tai.

units.source_text: 在高原的病榻上，他阅读了《书经》、《神仙通鉴》、《吕祖全书》等典籍。

en.t: On his sickbed in the highlands, he read classics such as the Book of Documents, Comprehensive Mirror of Immortals, and Complete Works of Patriarch Lu.

units.source_text: 昭和十一年，他加入了日本国籍，起了个日本名字：吴泉。

en.t: In Showa 11, he became a Japanese citizen and took the Japanese name Go Sen.
